messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: PID-799 / embeddings-queue saturation in eu-west (p95 enqueue latency > 6s). Pager triggered for oncall-primary. https://status.redwood.example/incident/PID-799
Marta G: I'm primary for this shift — taking lead. quick triage: are any customer-facing queues showing error spikes?
Ibrahim: saw errors for 2 customers (cust-acme, cust-loci). Not full 5xx but timeouts hitting SDK retries. p99 request->enqueue ~12s.
Sanjay: adding context — autoscaler didn't spawn new workers due to soft quota on dedicated pool A. There's a throttle on spot reclaim that blocked scale-out. investigating policy.
Marta G: ok. immediate plan: 1) throttle non-critical prefetch jobs, 2) route embedding requests for EU to fallback pool (eu-secondary-emb), 3) prewarm one worker in eu-secondary. Anyone obj?
Priya: +1. I'll flip the routing rule once Ibrahim confirms compatibility. Routing key: `region:eu AND model:embed-*` -> eu-secondary-emb (failover mode).
Ibrahim: compatibility check done — model quant/kv cache differences are acceptable for short term. Will patch routing.
Sanjay: I'm going to temporarily raise the pool limit for dedicated pool A by +2 instances (15m window) to relieve backlog. Command: `infractl pool update dedicated-A --max 18 --expiry 15m`
Marta G: good. while that runs: Priya, can you list the quick mitigation runbook steps so the secondary knows what to watch? paste them here.
Priya: runbook snippet:
```
Runbook: Embeddings queue saturation (short list)
1) Confirm enqueue latency via /observability/queues/embeddings?region=eu
2) If p95 > 3s: set routing rule to fallback pool
   - Console: Routing -> Create rule -> condition = region:eu AND model:embed-*, action=route:eu-secondary-emb
   - CLI: redwood route add --cond "region=eu && model=embed-*" --to eu-secondary-emb
3) Prewarm worker: infractl worker prewarm --pool eu-secondary-emb --count 1
4) If backlog > 1000: increase dedicated pool max by +2 temporarily
5) Notify customers affected and increase log retention for 1h
6) Revert when p95 enqueue < 1s for 15m
```
Marta G: thanks. Ibrahim — execute the routing change; Sanjay — do the pool bump. I'll draft the customer impact note.
Ibrahim: routing change applied. `redwood route add ...` returned success. Observability shows a small dip in enqueue spikes on eu-primary but backlog still ~1200.
Sanjay: pool bump issued, infra responded with `ok` and new desired=18. One worker is initializing (prewarm).
ops-bot: Deploy bot: `infractl pool update` completed (job id: job-8721).
Marta G: customer note draft (copy/edit): "We're experiencing elevated embedding request latency in eu-west affecting a subset of customers. We've routed traffic to a fallback pool and temporarily added capacity; mitigations in progress. No data loss. Engineers are monitoring p95/p99 and will post updates every 15m." Thoughts?
Priya: looks good. add estimated ETA: 30-45m to reach stable p95.
Sanjay: agree. Also call out if customers see mismatched embedding vectors due to quant differences, that's expected for short window.
Marta G: added that line. I'll send to #support after next update.
Ibrahim: monitoring: p95 reduced from 6.4s -> 2.4s after routing. backlog declining slowly (1200 -> 850). CPU on eu-secondary prewarm worker ~35%.
Marta G: great. Secondary coverage? Sanjay you're secondary, Sanjay / Priya please rotate who watches the bridge next 30m.
Sanjay: I'll stay on the bridge for the next 30. Priya please handle notifications and console checks.
Priya: on it. will post to support in ~15m if stable.
Marta G: handoff notes for next oncall (copy):
- current incident: PID-799 embeddings queue saturation (eu-west).
- mitigations applied: routing fallback to eu-secondary-emb, temporary pool max increase to 18, prewarmed worker x1.
- customer impact: subset of customers (cust-acme, cust-loci) experienced SDK timeouts/retries; no data loss. expect vector variance due to quant/kv differences while using fallback pool.
- key dashboards: /obs/queues/embeddings?region=eu, /obs/pools/dedicated-A, /alerts/PID-799
- runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.example/embeddings-queue-saturation
- next steps: monitor p95/p99 over 15m windows; if p95 > 3s after 45m -> escalate to infra oncall and consider further pool increase or divert to us-east.
Ibrahim: adding technical note: prefetch jobs detected as top enqueuer — suggestion to throttle them via `jobsctl throttle --tag prefetch --rate 0.2` if backlog persists.
Marta G: noted. coverage gap: EU overnight rotation has fewer engineers on pager — if this regresses after 02:00 UTC, escalate to oncall-lead. Documented in handoff.
Priya: posting update to support now with ETA 30-45m.
Marta G: final check-in before I sign off for break (15m): p95=1.1s, backlog=210, workers healthy. leaving Sanjay/Priya as active watchers. I'll leave a link to this thread in the incident page.
Sanjay: ack. taking bridge. thanks Marta.
Ibrahim: leaving monitoring on dashboard, will alert if p95 rises >2s.
ops-bot: Reminder: shift handoff checklist — please update rotation status in PagerDuty.
Marta G: updated PD. handing off.
Priya: confirmed PD updated and support post done. will ping again at +30m or on regression.
Marta G: thanks team. closing personal watch — incident remains open and assigned to oncall-primary -> Sanjay.
